groups.defect: Each async legacy write goroutine (Create, Delete, Update, DeleteCollection) builds its timeout from the request-scoped ctx, so the write can be cancelled when the handler returns; the legacy error is also no longer logged.
groups.rationale: All three report the same request-context problem at lines 51/110/135/163 and give the same fix (context.WithoutCancel or Background), and two of them add the missing error log.

groups.defect: On the storage error path, Create (line 45) and Update (line 129) call recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration, so storage failures count as legacy failures.
groups.rationale: All members flag the recordLegacyDuration(true, ...) call on the storage-failure branch of Create and/or Update. The same mistake appears in two places and one change fixes both.

groups.defect: On Delete's success path, recordStorageDuration receives `name` instead of options.Kind as the kind label.
groups.rationale: Every member points at line 106 and gives the same fix.

groups.defect: DeleteCollection's legacy goroutine records its result with recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration.
groups.rationale: Every member points at line 166 and gives the same single fix.

groups.defect: Delete puts the base d.Log into the context instead of the enriched `log`, so the name/kind/method fields are lost.
groups.rationale: Both flag line 97 and give the same fix.

groups.defect: The Mode3 tests never check or wait for the async legacy write: Create never asserts the legacy call, and Delete, Update and DeleteCollection set no legacy expectation and race with the goroutine.
groups.rationale: Both report that the tests don't observe the goroutine's legacy write, so they still pass if the write is removed. They cover different test functions, and one adds the race.
